import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
exp = df.iloc[10:22]  # expense line items rows 11-22 (0-indexed 10:22)
exp.columns = ['Category','Item','Amount']
exp = exp.dropna(subset=['Amount'])
exp['Amount'] = exp['Amount'].astype(float)

by_cat = exp.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum()
print('=== Total expenses by category ===')
for cat, amt in by_cat.items():
    print(f'{cat:>16}: \${amt:,.2f}')
total = exp['Amount'].sum()
print(f'{\"TOTAL\":>16}: \${total:,.2f}')
print()
print('Line items counted:', len(exp))
income = df.iloc[3:7,1].astype(float).sum()
print(f'Total income (B8): \${income:,.2f}')
"
